name: fable
description: Get the most out of Claude Fable 5 — Fable architects, cheaper models execute. Fable holds an opinion and defends it, gets on the same page with you first, then delegates execution to Opus 5, Sonnet 5, Haiku 4.5, or GPT-5.6 Sol via headless codex. Covers model routing, reasoning effort, and how to brief a worker. Always on via a SessionStart hook that injects it into every session.
